newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-THUNDERSTORMS FORCE SUSPENSION OF SECOND ROUND IN AKRON.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-THUNDERSTORMS FORCE SUSPENSION OF SECOND ROUND IN AKRON.

text.p: Thunderstorms forced the suspension of the World Series of Golf after just five players in the 43-man field had completed the second round on Friday.
Play initially was interrupted for more than 3-1/2 hours before resuming for two hours. But play was finally suspended for the day when the storm continued.
The 38 players are schedeled to resume their rounds on Saturday morning before the third round begins.
